pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: The Flame Drifter launches Small Annihilation Bombs and has a spinning attack. Move across its firing line during a shot wind-up and create distance during a spin. Its name and effect colors do not make Fire Resistance a universal defense against these hits.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Enderitium Gem, Bottle Of Annihilation. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
